server.name: locus-credits
server.title: Locus Pro API tools
server.description: Discover and run pay-per-use APIs against one governed Locus Pro credit balance.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Locus Pro: pay-per-use APIs billed to one credit balance.

For repeatable Workflows, load the registered locus-workflows skill when available; otherwise call get_locus_guide. Call web_research for grounded answers, web_extract for exact URLs, router_web_search for sources, or commerce_search for products. Otherwise use search_apis(query), then execute(slug, args) with its returned schema. For enabled:false, call request_tool_access and send its approval_url to the human. describe_api(slug) refreshes contracts. Use estimate_cost only for an exact quote or hard ceiling. Read balances with get_balance().

Calls are live and billed; charges appear in structuredContent and _meta. RETRIES: pass "idempotency_key" to execute (or _meta "locus/idempotencyKey" on any burn tool) — the same key never double-charges. Without one, retries deduplicate best-effort; intentional repeats need a fresh key. Replays carry idempotent_replay:true and no new charge. For quotes, reuse approval_token and idempotency_key unchanged; price movement returns MCP_APPROVAL_REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED before dispatch. Use ?compact=1 for compact text.

AUTH: interactive clients use discovered OAuth and consent. Service credentials include tenant keys and scoped agent credentials; end-user credentials remain user-bound. Failures return isError:true with an actionable hint.
